As respostas sobre tecnologia, pagamento: The answers on technology, payment and license feed layer 2; those on devices and internet feed layer 3 (infrastructure and devices); and the level of adaptation feeds layer 4 (data and systems integration). Krueger and Jackson (2026, pp. 7–8) point out that a free or donated tool does not remove life-cycle costs.
As sete camadas do quadro de Krueger e J: The seven layers of the Krueger and Jackson framework (2026, p. 11): 1 governance; 2 applications, user experience and adoption; 3 infrastructure and devices; 4 data and systems integration; 5 cybersecurity, privacy and compliance; 6 staff training and capacity; 7 operations, support and sustainability. The mapping between the tool's cost components (K1 to K6) and the layers is a convention of this tool.
Base da estimativa de custo depois do te: Basis for the cost estimate after the test.
Cada nível inclui os anteriores. Mais ad: Each level includes the previous ones. More adaptation increases deployment and maintenance costs.
Camada 1 · Governança, políticas e plane: Layer 1 · Governance, policy and life-cycle planning. In the layered total cost framework of Krueger and Jackson (2026, p. 11), this layer covers governance structures, policy, ethical review, procurement guidance, monitoring routines, legal review and life-cycle planning. The authors note that governance becomes part of the cost structure of operations.
Camada 2 · Aplicações de IA, experiência: Layer 2 · AI applications, user experience and adoption. This is what teachers, students and school leaders see and use: the tools and applications (what the AI does), the user experience (who uses it and how) and adoption (the conditions for use to happen, including subscriptions and licenses). According to Krueger and Jackson (2026, p. 11), it is the most visible part of the investment, but only one part of the life-cycle cost.
